verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is project-wide file-content search (⌘⇧F) across local or cloud workspaces, which helps locate code but does not explain how the codebase fits together. Conductor runs third-party coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex that could be asked about a repository, but no evidence documents codebase explanation or orientation as a feature. Missing for 10: architecture/codebase overview or explanation features, dependency or structure navigation, guidance on where to start changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
